scientific_integrity: The original choice law and historical estimation studies are credited. The new assertion concerns only the exact two-district response classification and aggregate inverse ambiguity. Computational tests are not treated as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Exactly two facilities and two mirrored-distance districts; fixed positive travel distances and fixed demand shares.
Effective attraction ratio is known; one aggregate share cannot necessarily determine the distance exponent.
Endogenous prices, outside purchase option and general geometries have not been treated.
Huff 1963 bibliographic evidence is month-level, not an exact publicly verified day; the selected historical anchor has an indexed July 1, 1964 day.
Relevant historic full texts inaccessible and broader rational-logit arguments may predate the claim.
title: Sharp market-share peak and two-exponent ambiguity in a two-district Huff model
